idea-plugin.name: NodeCanvas Usages
idea-plugin.description:
Shows and maintains usages of C# methods, properties and fields in NodeCanvas graphs (Behaviour Trees, FSMs, Dialogue Trees) of a Unity project.

  • Code Vision: NodeCanvas: N usages above members used by graphs, with navigation to the asset
  • Find Usages: graph usages in a separate NodeCanvas graphs group
  • Rename: renaming a member or type updates the graphs, byte-for-byte as Unity writes them
  • Members used only by graphs are no longer reported as unused

Not affiliated with Paradox Notion. Requires the Unity Support plugin with asset indexing enabled.
